verdict_rule.close: 장외 시점 예측만, 목표일 40개 후 판정

note: 사전등록 판정 전 중간 집계. 적중률을 결과로 인용하지 말 것. 투자 조언 아님.

sources.scores.json: turtle-forecast runner scores.jsonl (NucBox), one row per scored prediction; who = LLM name or signal-script name; hit = predicted direction matched; momentum_hit = naive momentum baseline on the same target; base/target = price at prediction / at target; ret_bp = return in basis points of entering at base in the predicted direction (long if up, short if down) and exiting at target, before costs; target_key = asset|horizon|target time, rows with the same key share one market outcome; close predictions made during the session are excluded (their base is the previous close, already partly known), as in PREREG
